subject: English
question_text: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives: 1 ✕ 7 =
stimulus: i. What thought strikes Sonabhan as she watches Ameen go along the riverbank? (a) He is leaving forever (b) He is scared inside (c) He will change his mind (d) He has grown up ii. What does Ameen share with his dead father physically? (a) Hair and eyes (b) Voice and smile (c) Long neck and straight shoulders (d) Skin tone and nose iii. What does Ameen seem fascinated by, according to Sonabhan? (a) Serving the country (b) Travelling (c) Fighting (d) Reading war stories iv. What traits does Ameen inherit from his father? (a) Shyness and honesty (b) Weakness and silence (c) Laziness and fear (d) Love for games and stubbornness v. What complaints did neighbours often bring to Sonabhan about Ameen? (a) He was too noisy (b) He played all day (c) He stole date juice (d) He skipped school vi. How did Sonabhan usually respond to the neighbours' complaints? (a) She scolded Ameen (b) She gave them eggs (c) She hid inside (d) She told them Ameen was not home vii. What does Sonabhan do at night after Ameen goes to sleep? (a) She cries in her bed (b) She writes in her diary (c) She watches him and touches his cheek (d) She cleans the house quietly
source: SSC English 1st Paper Seen Passage — Unit—1: Sense of Self, Lesson—1: ‘Mr. Moti’ by Rahat Abir (B)
